english.note: Use 原則 as the all-purpose choice for a guiding belief, a decision rule, or a moral standard.
Use this when the guideline is a broad principle or rule rather than a set of instructions.
Use 原則 as the all-purpose noun for a generally accepted principle or rule.
Use this for a general principle that guides what is considered right or appropriate.

examples.english: I have one principle: I never cheat customers.
examples.traditional: 我做人有個原則，就係唔呃客。
